answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor is the only stated option that independently meets the mandated 18% spend reduction, and prior memory indicates rapid onboarding and accurate invoicing. However, the 94% committed-volume line leaves little tolerance for a delivery or quality disruption. Verify the original low-cost-vendor record before committing, specifically for evidence on delivery, quality, capacity, and whether the prior switch involved this constrained component. Incumbent renewal or negotiation has proven stability and savings, but available evidence does not establish that either can meet the full 18% target within 14 days.
